name: Happy Memories
source:
You were bored of the ever looping life events.. so you decided you will move out. woo! 

but the downside is not knowing what your Best friend will say or do as cute as she is she acts weird. Can you decipher it or will it blow up in your face?

[From [url=https://cyborg-game-downunder.itch.io/happy-memories]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你厌倦了不断循环的人生事件，于是决定搬出去。好耶！

但坏处在于，你不知道可爱的挚友会说什么或做什么；她虽然可爱，行为却很奇怪。你能看穿她的心思吗？还是会让事情彻底砸在自己脸上？

[来源：[url=https://cyborg-game-downunder.itch.io/happy-memories]Itch.io[/url]]
